subject: general
question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 90, 94, 44, 97, 46, 72, 62, 44 and 54 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 70.

Deviations from 70 = +20, +24, −26, +27, −24, +2, −8, −26, −16.

Sum of deviations = 20 + 24 − 26 + 27 − 24 + 2 − 8 − 26 − 16 = −27

Net deviation per observation = −27 ÷ 9 = −3

Actual Mean = 70 − 3 = 67

**∴ The correct answer is 67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 90, 94, 44, 97, 46, 72, 62, 44, 54

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 Sum of 9 observations = 603 
• Divided equally into 9 parts Mean = 67 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 90 + 94 + 44 + 97 + 46 + 72 + 62 + 44 + 54

⇒ Sum = 603

⇒ Total number of observations = 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 603 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 67

**∴ The correct answer is 67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used when items have different frequencies or weights: Mean = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ)

Combined Mean

Used to find the combined mean of two merged groups: Combined Mean = (n₁m₁ + n₂m₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

Median and Mode

Median is the exact middle value of a sorted data set. Mode is the most frequently occurring value in the set.
